data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 77.553m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle, there was net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 27.9m (36% of opening reserves), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The report attributes loss impact to US hurricane events (Harvey and Irma) and notes foreign exchange effects; development was concentrated in casualty and property exposures. No quantified gross prior-year release figure was provided in a single labelled movement note, so the prior-year movement here is calculated from the gross claims development table.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (27.876m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative incurred claims rows) because the report did not provide a single labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure. The triangle is presented in GBP 000. Some OCR/formatting ambiguity exists in the reconciliation table; net prior-year movement figures are explicitly shown elsewhere (net amounts by LOB) and have been used for LOB movement mapping (net amounts). Reinsurance-to-close activity around the 2015 year is present in the underwriting accounts and could distort comparisons; RITC treatment was considered when selecting the triangle as the primary source.
